# SolidSyslog integration manifest — GENERATED by CMake (S30.03).
# Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: cmake --build <build-dir> --target manifest
# Scope: all
# Selected platforms: MbedTls, LwipRaw, FreeRtos, FatFs, StdAtomic
#
# A non-CMake integrator (IAR / Keil / MPLAB / CCS / Make) compiles the .c
# files below, with the include dirs on the compiler path, against their own
# config headers. See docs/build-integration.md for the walkthrough.

# Plus, located in YOUR project: each upstream library's own include dirs
# and the directory holding your config headers.

## Required defines

-DSOLIDSYSLOG_USER_TUNABLES_FILE="my_tunables.h"   # your tunable overrides (optional)
# lwIP: each adapter gates itself on the lwIP option it needs, so a source you
#       do not enable compiles to nothing. LWIP_DNS=1 enables the DNS resolver;
#       LWIP_UDP / LWIP_TCP the datagram / stream adapters.
# Mbed TLS: point MBEDTLS_USER_CONFIG_FILE (or MBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE) at your mbedtls config,
#           and use the SAME config when building the mbedTLS library itself.

## Language

C99 or later.
The StdAtomic platform requires C11 or later.

## Integrator-supplied config headers

mbedtls_config.h   (MbedTls)
lwipopts.h   (LwipRaw)
FreeRTOSConfig.h   (FreeRtos)
ffconf.h   (FatFs)
